## Board Member Training, Development and Self Evaluation

Geperal Biringham Board of Education members shall pursue ongoing training to develop and and operations.  Training will include participation in:

- Orientation for newly elected or appointed school board members;
- 6 Training or consulting workshops for the local Board as a whole;
- State or national school board association events addressing Board governance or operation; or other Board member development opportunities relating to leadership development Board govemance, or Board operations.

Source of Irining andRepot Ihe requirements of this policy will be satisfied by participation in training provided by the Alabarna Association of School Boards or other sources considered knowledgeable in school board governance and leadership and approved by the Board  Bcard members will provide a report to the Board aboui training experiences at the next available Board meeting

Board\_Self\_Evaluation The Board believes that evaluation of its effectiveness will improve the Board ' s perfommance; exemplify the kind of constructive assessments the Board encourages for all school personnel programs; and promote a of teamwork throughout the school system The Board will assess its own performance annually according to established by the Board This inforation will be used by the Board each year in establishing the and objectives it will strive to accomplish duing the subsequent year. and spirit goals goals
